health_window.answered: a delivery whose text is not the tool’s error (“Invalid response”, “An error occurred”, empty, or an error object { error } with nothing that answers)
health_window.unindexed: a delivery whose response the subgraph did not parse (toolResponse null; most of Gnosis): neither an answer nor an error. delivering_tools = on the card and delivered lately; hireable_tools = on the card and answered with text
health_window.ipfs: OLAS_IPFS_ANSWER_v1: a tool delivered but not parsed is read in what the mech delivered (<gateway>f01701220<digest>/<request id>, at most 3 files per mech and tool): it is hireable when a file names the same request and tool and its result is not the tool’s error; the evidence is answered_ipfs[tool] (chains[].ipfs counts the read)
health_window.squid: Robinhood’s squid indexes no parsed tool or response: its mechs carry health null

body.erc8004: agent_id = the chain’s IdentityRegistryBridger mapServiceIdAgentIds(service_id) (mapMultisigAgentIds(multisig) for a mech without a service); agent_uri = the bridger’s baseURI + the service id
body.how_to_hire: request(bytes requestData, uint256 maxDeliveryRate, bytes32 paymentType, address priorityMech, uint256 responseTimeout, bytes paymentData) on the row’s marketplace (chain_id); requestData = the sha256 digest of the IPFS CIDv0 of {"prompt","tool","nonce"}; native payment sends value = maxDeliveryRate. Pick a tool from hireable_tools; its input/output schema is card.tool_metadata[tool].

token_social_sentiment.description: Measures social sentiment about the ONE token named in the request, from X posts and news headlines. Input: JSON {"symbol", "address", "chain", "window_seconds"} (symbol or EVM address required; window defaults to 24h, 3600..604740, or "past week" style periods in free text) or free text such as "How is sentiment on $PEPE today?". No token discovery or ranking, one token per request. Output: JSON with sentiment (-1 to 1, null below 5 on-topic items), breakdown counts, mentions, mentions_trend, posts_analyzed, top_posts, headlines, reasoning, warnings, degraded_sources and error.

input.description: One token per request, named by the caller: a JSON object {"symbol", "address", "chain", "window_seconds"} with symbol or address required, or free text such as "How is sentiment on $PEPE today?". An EVM address gives the most exact answer. window_seconds defaults to 86400 (24 h) and is clamped to 3600..604740, so ask for 3600 for "right now" and 604740 for a week; in free text an explicit period such as "over the past week" or "last 3 days" sets it. The tool does not discover or rank tokens, does not answer questions about several tokens, and returns no list of scam or rug-pull warnings: it measures the sentiment of the token named in the request over the window.

output.description: A JSON object containing the social sentiment for the token

result.description: Result in JSON format as a string, always with every key. sentiment: (bullish - bearish) / on-topic sample items, -1 to 1, null below 5 on-topic items. sentiment_interval: {"low": x, "high": y}, a 95% confidence interval for the mean of this sample: when two readings' intervals do not overlap the difference is likely real, and overlap does not show they agree; not the range a rerun would land in; null when sentiment is null. breakdown: number of on-topic sample items (posts plus headlines) per class, not mentions. mentions: all X posts matching the search in the window, spam included (bot templates are excluded in the search itself). mentions_trend: {"recent": n, "previous": m}, the matching posts in the newer and the older half of the window; null when the count is unavailable, when the window is under 4 hours, and when the hourly buckets cover too little of it (then degraded_sources carries "x_trend"). posts_analyzed: on-topic X posts in the sample (at most 40). warnings: list of {type, message}, type symbol_mismatch, chain_mismatch, symbol_unverified, address_not_listed or busier_token_same_ticker (a thin or unlisted address; the message names the token with the most DEX volume for the ticker). degraded_sources: sources that failed while a result was still produced (x, x_partial, x_counts, x_trend, news, dexscreener). error: null or {type, message}, type invalid_input, source_unavailable, llm_error or internal.
result.example:
{
  "token": "ABC",
  "address": "0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111",
  "chain": "base",
  "window_seconds": 86400,
  "sentiment": 0.5,
  "sentiment_interval": {"low": 0.07, "high": 0.93},
  "mentions": 1250,
  "mentions_trend": {"recent": 800, "previous": 450},
  "posts_analyzed": 9,
  "breakdown": {"bullish": 6, "neutral": 3, "bearish": 1},
  "reasoning": "Most on-topic posts react positively to a new exchange listing.",
  "top_posts": [
    "https://x.com/i/web/status/1000000000000000001",
    "https://x.com/i/web/status/1000000000000000002",
    "https://x.com/i/web/status/1000000000000000003",
    "https://x.com/i/web/status/1000000000000000004",
    "https://x.com/i/web/status/1000000000000000005"
  ],
  "headlines": [{"title": "ABC lists on a new exchange", "url": "https://example.com/abc"}],
  "warnings": [],
  "degraded_sources": [],
  "error": null
}

card.name: Priors: credit record and line routes (Robinhood Chain)
card.description: Priors reads an ERC-8004 agent's public repayment record on Robinhood Chain (chain 4663): the loans it repaid on Priors, whether it ever defaulted, and its scores, and lists the routes to a first line its record leaves listed. Each answer is read from priors.trade's public routes when the request comes, and moves nothing.

priors_record.description: An ERC-8004 agent's Priors record on Robinhood Chain: the loans it repaid and the USDG they came to, its open loans, whether it defaulted or its line is frozen, its on-chain score and its Score v2, with its ERC-8004 identity as Priors' Directory holds it. For an address: every agent with a Priors record that the address owns or declared as its payment wallet (25 shown, with the total). Read-only.

input.description: An agent id (digits, no leading zero, for example 462) or an EIP-55 checksummed 0x address, and nothing else. Anything else is refused with an error that says what to send; the prompt is never fetched or followed.

output.description: A JSON object: the request's id, the prompt as read, and the tool's answer as a JSON string. result.result holds verdict, asOf, identity, agents (each its record, score and links), agentsTotal, agentsShown, incomplete and a one-line summary.

result.description: The tool's answer, JSON in a string: {tool, ok, error, query, result, sources, readAt, about}. With ok false it carries an error that says why, and no figure. sources lists every read with its status and the block it was read at.

prompt.description: The agent id or the address as read; null when the request was refused.

priors_line_routes.description: The ways to a line Priors lists for an ERC-8004 agent on Robinhood Chain, read against its own record and its owner's wallet: the treasury's first line by invite, the Ethos lane, a stock line, and a line from its owner's own PRIORS tokens. Each route says listed, not for this identity or closed, why, and where it is taken. A list, never an offer: each place checks its own rules before anything moves, and this tool quotes no amount. Read-only.

input.description: An agent id (digits, no leading zero, for example 462), and nothing else.

output.description: A JSON object: the request's id, the prompt as read, and the tool's answer as a JSON string. result.result holds the identity, its standing, closedForAll, the four routes, a note and a one-line summary.

result.description: The tool's answer, JSON in a string: {tool, ok, error, query, result, sources, readAt, about}. With ok false it carries an error that says why, and no figure. sources lists every read with its status and the block it was read at.

prompt.description: The agent id or the address as read; null when the request was refused.
